virality_data.topic: Building a custom Model Context Protocol (MCP) server to automate invoice and receipt auditing
virality_data.analysis: With Dev.to sounding alarms on MCP's hidden design flaws and enterprise devs scrambling to automate finance ops with local LLMs, practical MCP implementations are seeing explosive engagement. Medium readers are fatigued by simple chatbot tutorials and actively look for operational AI bridges between raw PDFs, bank records, and accounting ledgers. This post provides a tangible, copy-paste FastMCP script in Python that extracts structured ledger entries from chaotic invoices without third-party SaaS fees.

virality_data.topic: Building an Agent Skill Harness with persistent memory and dynamic tool injection in Python
virality_data.analysis: The explosion of obra/superpowers and affaan-m/ECC on GitHub highlights an industry-wide realization: monolithic prompt loops are dead, and modular 'skills' systems with memory reflection are the standard for 2026. Medium readers are actively migrating away from brittle LangChain abstractions to lightweight, decoupled agent harnesses. Demonstrating how to build an explicit tool-switching memory harness in pure Python addresses developers' highest-ranked agent pain point: tool drift and context blowout.

virality_data.money_angle: Reduced wasted OpenAI tool-calling token bills by 65% through dynamic skill injection
virality_data.story_angle: My coding agent kept dumping 40 tool schemas into its prompt window until it ran out of tokens, so I wrote an open skill harness that hot-swaps tools into context based on task intent.
